name: glasspane-mcp
description: GlassPane MCP stdio shell: JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio bridging an AI agent to the glasspane engine daemon

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --external:zod --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/http-gateway.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --external:zod --outfile=dist/http-gateway.js && esbuild src/http-gateway-cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --external:zod --outfile=dist/http-gateway-cli.js && rm -f dist/*.js.map dist/*.d.ts.map && find dist -maxdepth 1 -name '*.js' ! -name 'index.js' ! -name 'http-gateway.js' ! -name 'http-gateway-cli.js' -delete && rm -rf schemas && mkdir -p schemas && cp -R ../kernel/schemas/. schemas/
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run bundle

author: jingzhao-l
